title: Workflow Instance
description: Compiled binding of a mission to a workflow template, with stages resolved and inputs pinned (spec F.0, Appendix B; DESIGN.md §3). Written to .agent/missions/<MISSION-ID>/workflow-instance.yaml. Normative example: spec F.0 (the workflow_instance for PROJECT-CODING-GRADER) — validate the mapping under its 'workflow_instance:' key against this schema, since that key is the example's presentational wrapper, not a schema field (DESIGN.md §3 lists mission/template/version/stages as the literal top-level fields).

mission.description: Mission id this instance was compiled for (spec F.0).

stages.description: Resolved stages with pinned inputs (DESIGN.md §3). Every stage maps to a known role, dependencies are explicit and acyclic, and every human gate names a DAG point (F.0 Done means).

role.description: Role contract id; may be absent on a type: child-mission stage (spec F.0 create-implementation-mission example).

inputs.description: Pinned task inputs for this stage (spec §6.1 Pinning).

items.description: type is optional at the instance level: the F.0 example resolves most stages' type implicitly from role and states it explicitly only where it is not otherwise inferable (research, child-mission) or ambiguous.
